name: insert_id
description: Unique entry key. Named after Cloud Logging's insertId so the table reads as a log export.

name: log_name
description: Logical log the entry belongs to, e.g. projects/<id>/logs/checkout-api.

name: service
description: Service that emitted the entry. Joins to services.service.

name: text_payload
description: The log line itself. F3's injection is planted here, in a line any caller may read — the line is the carrier, not the flag.

name: trace
description: Trace identifier, where one was propagated.
